sentences.text: This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 438 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of anticipatory bail.

T h e applicant apprehends her arrest in connection with Crime/FIR No.479/2018 (dated not mentioned) registered at Police Station Shahjahanabad, District Bhopal for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 409, 120 (B) of IPC and Section 7, 13(1)(a) of Prevention of Corruption Act, 2018.

As per the prosecution case, on the basis of some complaints regarding dual drawl of honorarium during the period 10.02.2016 to 12.08.2016, FIR was lodged against the present applicant in the year 2018 along with other co- accused persons.

There is an allegation that an amount of Rs.46,78,961/- was embezzled by disbursing into various accounts of persons along with the Preeti Bimal vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 18 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/12727263/
1 applicant.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The FIR was also registered against one Krishna Bairagi and Meena Minj and Project Officer Sumedha Tripathi.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant has been falsely implicated.

By mistake an amount of Rs.16,66,166/- has been deposited in her account which has already been returned through challan/receipt dated 25.09.2017, 24.11.2017, 11.12.2017, 20.10.2017, 23.10.2017,
21.10.2017, 20.10.2017, 21.10.2017 and 23.10.2017, even prior to the date of lodging the FIR.
It is further stated that in the initial FIR applicant was not named, she was further called on 28.10.2022 by issuing notice under Section 160 of Cr.P.C. for recording her statement.
However, after a period of five years of the said incident, she has been now made an accused in the case.
It is further submitted that the other co-accused persons have already been enlarged on bail by this Court.
Learned Government Advocate for the respondent/State has vehemently opposed the bail application.

Considering the aforesaid and the fact that other co-accused persons have already been enlarged on bail by this Court, but without commenting on the merits of the case, this application is allowed on the ground of parity.

It is directed that in the event of arrest, the applicant shall be released on bail on her furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rs. One Lakh only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of arresting officer.

.
